title: Example clue: meticulous
instructions: Choose the meaning that best fits the sentence.

parts.prompt: Noor was meticulous when preparing the exhibition: she checked every label, measured every gap and corrected even tiny spelling errors. What does “meticulous” most nearly mean?

choice_rationales.A: The repeated checking and attention to tiny errors show great care.
choice_rationales.B: The actions are patient and thorough rather than impatient.
choice_rationales.C: The sentence describes accuracy, not originality.
choice_rationales.D: Nothing suggests Noor hides her work.

parts.hint: List the actions Noor performs and identify the quality they share.
parts.correct_explanation: The examples all show close, careful attention to detail.
